comment: NosE dehydrates Ser/Thr residues together with NosD analogous to the lanthipeptide dehydratase LanB. MIA-addition by NosIJK increases catalytic efficiency but is not essential.

reactions.description: Dehydratation of Ser/Thr residues to Dha/Dhb in the biosynthetic pathway of nosiheptide, after NosIJK-catalyzed addition of MIA. Current knowledge indicates that the full leader peptide is required for substrate recognition.
Dehydratation of Ser/Thr residues on nascent NosM precursor peptide.

Dehydratation of Ser/Thr residues to Dha/Dhb in the biosynthetic pathway of nosiheptide, without attached MIA heterocycle (in vitro reaction). Current knowledge indicates that the full leader peptide is required for substrate recognition.
Dehydratation of Ser/Thr residues on nascent NosM precursor peptide.
